verdict.rationale: Unleash's Admin API gives programmatic access to all resources, so an agent can read experiment configurations such as flags and A/B variants. Its official MCP server lets coding assistants manage flags. Impact metrics show Unleash tracks rollout health thresholds, but nothing shows an agent can programmatically retrieve experiment results or outcome statistics to summarize them. missing for 10: a documented API/MCP endpoint for reading experiment results or variant performance, statistical outcome data for ship/rollback recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
